results.title: UP Cabinet approves lifelong free bus travel for women aged 60 and above
results.description: The Uttar Pradesh Cabinet has approved lifelong free travel on UPSRTC buses for women aged 60 and above under the Lokmata Ahilyabai Matrushakti Yojana. The Cabinet also cleared the Ganga Expressway extension to Haridwar and an industrial and logistics cluster in Sultanpur.

results.title: ‘Vacate in 6 weeks’: Delhi HC orders 350+ slum dwellers near PM House to relocate
results.description: The Delhi High Court on Tuesday directed more than 350 residents of three slum clusters near the Prime Minister’s residence in the Race Course area to vacate their homes within six weeks and relocate to alternative accommodation at Savda Ghevra.
